scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && (cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund)
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && (cd client && npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build) && if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/drizzle-kit push --config=src/db/drizzle.external.config.ts --force || true; fi
scripts.start: if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/drizzle-kit push --config=src/db/drizzle.external.config.ts --force || true; fi && ./node_modules/.bin/tsx server/server.js
scripts.dev: if [ ! -s client/dist/index.html ] || [ ! -d client/dist/assets ]; then npm --prefix client run build; fi && ./node_modules/.bin/tsx server/server.js
scripts.lint: for f in server/*.js server/config/*.js server/constants/*.js server/controllers/*.js server/middlewares/*.js server/routes/*.js server/services/*.js server/utils/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
